terms.LLM-guided search: Symbolic execution prioritized by LLM branch preferences; model verdicts do not accept witnesses.
terms.branch preference: A validated (branch_id, visit, take) tuple used only for state priority.
terms.retained frontier: The same pending symbolic states across guidance, feedback and fallback phases.
terms.source verification: Checking a zero denominator against source-derived path and definedness constraints.
terms.confirmed witness: An input accepted by source verification; compiled C/UBSan validation is reported separately.
terms.complete refutation: Exhaustive rejection of the target defect within the supported source model, with no incompleteness event.
terms.unknown: No confirmed witness and incomplete exploration or unsupported semantics; not a safety proof.
terms.operation budget: A shared cap charging symbolic state pops and, for SMT lookahead, summary-node visits.
terms.solver-call budget: A separate cap on solver queries, including lookahead queries.
terms.end-to-end time: Parent-observed elapsed time including startup, parsing, provider waiting, search and return.
terms.model request: An actual provider invocation; distinct from reuse of recorded branch preferences.

notes: Method labels are shared by generated tables and Python plots. Narrative prose defines each policy.
The star marks the separately frozen, later exploratory SMT-first extension.
Do not rename frozen JSON keys, archived reports, prompt schemas or recorded experiment data.
Safe/bug remain valid benchmark labels and verbatim model verdicts; safe is not a synonym for complete refutation.
